title: Go: WebSocket Server
description: Build a WebSocket server with message broadcasting, client lifecycle management, and ping/pong keepalive.

steps.title: Upgrade HTTP to WebSocket
steps.description: Create an HTTP handler that upgrades the connection using `gorilla/websocket.Upgrader`. Define an `Upgrader` with `CheckOrigin` returning `true`. Use `upgrader.Upgrade(w, r, nil)` to get a `*websocket.Conn`. Print "WebSocket connected" using `fmt.Println`.
hints: Upgrader must allow origin for local testing

steps.title: Read and write messages
steps.description: Start two goroutines: one reads messages with `conn.ReadMessage()`, one writes with `conn.WriteMessage()`. Use a channel to pass messages from reader to writer. Print received messages using `fmt.Printf("Received: %s\n", msg)`.
hints: Use textMessage constant for text payloads

verification.failureMessage: Print 'Received: message' for each incoming message.

steps.title: Broadcast to all clients
steps.description: Create a `Broadcaster` struct with `clients map[*websocket.Conn]bool` and a `broadcast chan []byte`. A `Start()` goroutine iterates all clients in a select loop, writing each message. Print broadcast count using `fmt.Printf("Broadcast to %d clients\n", n)`.
hints: Serialize all writes through a single goroutine
Remove clients that fail to write
Use a sync.RWMutex if accessing the map outside the goroutine

verification.failureMessage: Print the number of clients a message was broadcast to.

steps.title: Handle client disconnect
steps.description: Detect client disconnection by checking for closed connection errors from `ReadMessage` (`websocket.IsCloseError`, `websocket.ErrCloseSent`). Register/unregister clients via channels. Print disconnect events using `fmt.Printf("Client %s disconnected\n", conn.RemoteAddr())`.
hints: ReadMessage returns an error on close
Use register/unregister channels for safe map access
Close the connection and clean up resources

steps.title: Ping/pong keepalive
steps.description: Configure the upgrader with `ReadDeadline` and set `PongHandler`. Use `conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(60*time.Second))`. Send periodic pings from the server with `conn.WriteControl(websocket.PingMessage, ...)`. Print ping/pong activity using `fmt.Printf`.
hints: PongHandler updates the read deadline on each pong
Use a ticker to send pings periodically

verification.failureMessage: Print ping and pong events as they occur.

steps.title: Chat room implementation
steps.description: Build a simple chat room: clients send JSON `{"type":"chat","data":{"user":"alice","message":"hello"}}`. Parse with `json.Unmarshal`, add server timestamp, and broadcast to all clients. Print formatted chat messages using `fmt.Printf("[%s] %s: %s\n", ...)`.
hints: Define a Message struct with Type and Data fields
Add a timestamp field server-side before broadcast

verification.failureMessage: Print formatted chat messages with user and content.
